preregistration.primary_outcome: Joint success: edit_ok AND subject_ok AND pattern_ok AND NOT artifact; all planned outputs in denominator; pending stays pending.
preregistration.development_reference: R80 ONLINE25 required for paired development contrasts; no guessed or substituted results.
preregistration.mask_semantics: ONLINE means online RMS, not automatic segmentation. Development masks are supplied ROIs; heldout AUTO_DETAIL uses only source pixels.
preregistration.selection: Report all predefined heldout candidates. Heldout pilot is independent of previous six sources, not a final untouched test after using it for selection.
preregistration.statistics: Pair by source/task/seed; aggregate within source before bootstrap. Deterministic RF-Edit repeated seeds are not independent evidence.
preregistration.evaluation: Native PNG automatic metrics; compact JPEG for viewing only; no metric-derived human labels.
preregistration.heldout_evaluation: PIE editing mask is evaluation-only. Method supports are source-only contrast or global; no evaluation ROI or mask is used by AUTO_DETAIL. Whole-image NCC is auxiliary, not a pattern-specific score.
preregistration.heldout_tasks: 24 tasks selected before outputs by category round-robin and deterministic hash order. All 10 edit categories, including object changes; report all and each category. Preserve only content not requested to change.

delivery.compact: preview.jpg, pattern.jpg, route_mask.jpg, comparison sheets, CSV and compact step summaries
delivery.native_png: Kept on server under package/results for native-resolution evaluation; not bundled in compact result ZIP
